name: Minatsuki Shinju
source:
An angel who came to the lower world like Hisui. He doesn't want to disturb him.

He grew up with Hisui and loves him. He's a little too paranoid and hates it... still, he's a spontaneous cutie.

Hobby: Making stuffed animals

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160726163418/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/p_sinjyu.html]official website[/url]]
